content:
Here are some key facts about Aristotle in (subject, predicate, object) triples:

1. (Aristotle, was, a Greek philosopher)
2. (Aristotle, lived, from 384 BCE to 322 BCE)
3. (Aristotle, was, a student of Plato)
4. (Aristotle, founded, the Lyceum)
5. (Aristotle, made, important contributions to various fields)
6. (Aristotle, developed, a system of logic)
7. (Aristotle, wrote, on physics, metaphysics, ethics, politics, and other subjects)
8. (Aristotle, was, the tutor of Alexander the Great)
9. (Aristotle, influenced, many later philosophers and thinkers)
10. (Aristotle, is considered, one of the most important figures in the history of philosophy)
